name: Minami Tsubame
source:
Her real name is Nakamori Tsubame. Minami is her maiden name. She is a teacher at Keiyo University Affiliated Fujikawa High School, teaching modern literature. She is the homeroom teacher for Itsuki and Nene's class. Her expressions are often abstract and unique, sometimes leaving her students perplexed. While she shows kindness by personally advising her student Sae on career paths, her relationship with her daughter Setsuka is not going very well.
[translated from digital setting materials]
